title: Algorithmic ER Triage & Resource Dispatch System
summary: Rule-based triage system calculating patient priority from vital signals and automating emergency resource dispatch.
problem: In a high-load ER, staff coordinate patient priority and free resources by hand, which is slow and inconsistent.
solution: A rule-based score built from SpO₂, heart rate and symptoms routes each patient to CRITICAL or STABLE and queues a dispatch of the available resources.

title: Automated Web Scraper & Telegram Bot
summary: Lightweight automation pipeline extracting structured DOM data and dispatching instant webhook alerts to Telegram channels.
problem: Checking product listings by hand means missing price drops and restocks.
solution: A scheduled scraper parses each page into structured data, compares it against a target price, and pushes an instant alert through the Telegram Bot API.
